The skin biopsy results showing chronic inflammatory cells suggestive of leprosy, combined with your sensory neuropathy (numbness and tingling) and hypopigmented macules, strongly point to Hansen's disease. The rash may be a concurrent dermatological issue or related to the disease's cutaneous manifestations, but the biopsy and nerve involvement are diagnostic.
